prompt:
Our regulatory affairs team needs to compile a document audit package for our EMA submission. We have three clinical trial PDF reports stored under `data/raw/clinical_trials/`. For each document, we need:
1. The document's official provenance information (title, author, and any other available document properties).
2. An abbreviated text extract covering only the first 2 pages of each report — we only need the abstract/executive summary and methods sections, not the full document.

Please produce a single file called `audit_report.json` that consolidates, for each PDF, its metadata and its 2-page text extract. This file will be attached to our regulatory dossier.
